### Making healthy behavior fit real life.

I am a health-behavior scientist studying how physical activity and other health-promoting behaviors can be integrated into everyday life. My research focuses on intervention fit: when, for whom, and under what conditions healthy behavior is feasible, effective, and sustainable.

:::

:::

## Research

I study how movement can be integrated into work and everyday life, with current projects examining active workstations, walking around stressful events, individual differences in intervention response, and sustained movement use.

[Read more about my research](research.qmd)

## Teaching & Mentoring

My teaching and mentoring focus on helping students become increasingly independent thinkers and researchers. I use active learning and scaffolded projects in the classroom, and I mentor research assistants from initial training through project leadership, conference presentations, and manuscript involvement.

[Read more about my teaching](teaching.qmd)  

[Read more about my mentoring](mentoring.qmd)
